cards.title: Ikea Shop Reveals Parenting Wisdom Gaps
cards.body: A parent's pre-university shopping trip to Ikea becomes a reality check on domestic wisdom imparted to children. The experience highlights how much—or how little—kids absorb about practical life skills.

cards.title: Kids' Quiz: Test Your Knowledge
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions created by children challenge your general knowledge on topics like octopus blood and sky weight. You can also submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: Moving to Suburbs: Finding Joy With Kids
cards.body: A family's suburban relocation initially feels disappointing until they discover excitement in unexpected places. The shift in perspective transforms how they experience community with their children.

cards.title: Safe Alcohol Use During Pregnancy Guide
cards.body: Understanding whether any amount of alcohol is safe during pregnancy is crucial for fetal health. Learn about timing, risks, and evidence-based guidance for expectant parents.

cards.title: New Law Protects Children From Nude Images
cards.body: The government will legislate to force tech firms to prevent children from taking or sharing nude images online. Companies may avoid enforcement if they implement safeguards proactively.
